Welcome. Imagine getting a gold star, a high grade, or maybe a bonus at work—sounds like a surefire way to keep us motivated, right? But what if those rewards aren’t really helping us grow the way we think?
Together, we’re about to explore the surprising world that Alfie Kohn reveals in Punished by Rewards. He invites us to look beneath the surface—beyond the shiny incentives that fill our classrooms, workplaces, and even our homes. The big question is: do these rewards actually inspire us, or could they be quietly draining our curiosity and creativity?
As we dive in, you’ll discover how the promise of praise, prizes, or perks can sometimes do more harm than good. Kohn’s insights show us the hidden ways these reward systems can chip away at our natural drive, leaving us chasing approval instead of real achievement. So, let’s pull back the curtain together. We’ll rethink what truly motivates us, and imagine a new path—one that values autonomy, deep curiosity, and genuine connection, instead of just short-term wins. Ready to see what lies beyond the gold stars? Let’s get started.
